_comment: SkillFoundry framework configuration. All keys are optional — defaults shown.
_tone_note: cold-blooded: original persona language (merciless, brutal, rejected). professional: same logic, neutral language (issues found, review required, blocked).
_execution_mode_note: auto: detected at runtime via _execution-context.md. real/advisory: forced override.
_complexity_routing_note: When true, /feature auto-classifies MICRO/SMALL/MEDIUM/LARGE and scales pipeline depth. Disable to always run full pipeline.

semgrep._enabled_note: auto: runs if semgrep is installed. always: fail pipeline if semgrep missing. never: LLM-only security.
semgrep._registry_note: Registry rules require internet access. Remove entries to run offline.

reports._generate_html_note: Single-file HTML report per feature/forge run. Set to false to disable.

_audit_webhook_note: Optional: POST audit entries to this URL after writing locally. See agents/_audit-export.md. Use ${ENV_VAR} for token substitution.

feature._shadow_tester_note: Runs shadow tester in parallel with coder to generate risk list for evaluator.

overrides._note: All --override decisions are logged here with timestamp, stage, reason, and user.
